arithmetic.cycle_field_argument: Permutation monomials are products of Gram cycles; determinant belongs to the ground field.
arithmetic.general_field_argument: Vinberg Proposition17, original printed p91, checked directly: k=Q(det L). Alternatively a proper extension k/Q(det L) has a nonidentity real embedding fixing the negative determinant, contradicting conjugate PSD.
arithmetic.intersection_argument: Odd-degree k intersects the degree4 multiquadratic field only in Q.
arithmetic.conjugate_argument: A negative rational principal determinant stays negative under a nonidentity ground-field embedding, contradicting conjugate PSD.

source_proof_scope.compactness: Required globally to exclude affine subdiagrams and make all proper missing-face sets spherical.
source_proof_scope.triangle: A minimal indefinite star subdiagram contains all three black roots, hence is exactly their connected triple.
source_proof_scope.quadrilateral: Opposite-pair subdiagrams contain minimal indefinite diagrams with <=1 white node each; index1 forces overlap or a cross-edge.
source_proof_scope.arithmetic: Any arithmetic ground field not contained in Q(sqrt2,sqrt5), including every nontrivial odd-degree field. Only the determinant-generation consequence of admissibility is used; no integrality census or fixed-lattice assumption.
source_proof_scope.omitted: No independent enumeration of the producer optional seven Lanner triangles; not needed for the dimension proof.

conclusion: Compact Coxeter polytopes with every Lanner diagram of order<=3 have dimension<=28. The arithmetic corollary applies to every ground field not contained in Q(sqrt2,sqrt5), in particular cubic-seven. No unrestricted compact28 claim.
